wins: Managed to accumulate 90 reward points in the single episode, showing effective execution of the initial reconnaissance and foothold steps based on the reward structure.
Engaged mentor guidance 10 times, indicating thorough attempt to adapt tactics when encountering blocked progress.
fails: Failed to reach the mission success condition despite high reward accumulation, driving the 0% success rate.
Repeatedly stalled in the post-exploitation phase, suggesting missing automation or decision rules for final objective completion.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong early-stage actions earned high rewards, but the agent consistently halted before delivering the final objective, requiring targeted refinement for goal completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent accumulates reward during entry but fails to execute the final objective, even after mentor intervention.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is detected open with an SSH banner response
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap with credential guessing scripts to identify valid login paths

skill_cards.if_condition: Upon discovering multiple open TCP ports after initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke focused service mapping to correlate open services with exploitation vectors

skill_cards.if_condition: After achieving initial shell but before terminating session
skill_cards.then_action: Validate objective completion using checklist (flags, persistence, data exfiltration) and escalate based on missing items

memory_ops.reason: High reward contributions from early reconnaissance justify prioritizing automated SSH enumeration.
Consistency with reward accumulation but failure to close objectives indicates need to reinforce post-exploit validation.

next_experiments.title: Formalize post-exploit checklist automation
